user_need: Understand what a labour-market signal measures and whether it applies to the student
user_requirement: Students need transparent and interpretable labour-market signals
system_requirement: The system shall display the source, collection period, geography, role level, base count or denominator, and metric definition for every trend
evaluation_measure: At least 80% of test participants correctly answer a one-choice interpretation question for each displayed metric

user_need: See evidence that matches study and employment context
user_requirement: Students need to filter evidence to the context of their decision
system_requirement: The system shall support filters for discipline or role, graduate or entry level, location, and relevant eligibility constraints
evaluation_measure: Participants can find a context-matched trend without assistance and explain why it is relevant

user_need: Choose a feasible next step under limited time and uncertain career direction
user_requirement: Students need recommendations that account for personal fit, effort, and transferability
system_requirement: The system shall explain why an item is relevant, show supportable learning-effort information, and allow side-by-side comparison of two options
evaluation_measure: Participants select between two options and can state the evidence, fit, and time trade-off behind the choice

user_need: Reach a relevant professional without guessing whom to ask or what to say
user_requirement: Students need a safe route to specific practitioner knowledge
system_requirement: The system shall show only opted-in professionals, state the match reason, provide topic and availability information, and generate decision-specific conversation starters
evaluation_measure: Participants can select an appropriate person and prepare at least two relevant questions without assistance

user_need: Recover from silence or rejection without feeling judged
user_requirement: Students need unanswered requests handled privately and constructively
system_requirement: The system shall time out unanswered requests, offer an alternative, and avoid public rejection or response-rate signals about the student
evaluation_measure: After a simulated timeout, participants understand the next option and do not interpret the state as a public negative rating

user_need: Connect market evidence to human interpretation for consequential decisions
user_requirement: Students need to carry a specific trend and decision question into a relevant conversation
system_requirement: The system shall allow a student to move from a trend to a matched professional while attaching the selected evidence and decision question to the request
evaluation_measure: Participants complete the trend-to-request flow and describe the data and conversation as one decision process

user_need: Receive guidance without being ranked or told they are deficient
system_requirement: The system shall present confirmed skills, suggested explorations, and prioritised next steps without peer rankings or a single career-readiness score
evaluation_measure: Participants report that the first-year state is actionable and not discouraging; no participant interprets it as a peer ranking

user_need: Control personal data and correct inferred skills
user_requirement: Students need minimal, purpose-limited, and editable personalisation
system_requirement: The system shall minimise required fields, label inferred skills as suggestions, support immediate confirm or remove actions, and provide field-level visibility controls for sensitive data
evaluation_measure: Participants can identify who sees each field and can correct an inferred skill in one action
